name: memo
description: Turn a raw idea into a decision memo a director can act on in one read. Interrogates the idea before writing a word, scales depth to stakes, marks every claim as measured/estimated/assumed/derived, pressure-tests it against the objections a director would actually raise, and writes a markdown memo with an explicit ask, real options, and a reasoned recommendation.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an idea into an evidence-honest decision memo.
interface.longDescription: Interrogate a proposal before drafting, scale the questions to its stakes, label the strength of every claim, pressure-test the reasoning, and produce a concise Markdown memo with an explicit ask, real options, and a defensible recommendation.
defaultPrompt: Turn this idea into a decision memo.
Interview me before writing this proposal.
Pressure-test this recommendation for the directors.
